The repaired candidate derives both reservations from the configured participant bound and passes a maintained 50-participant authority regression.

botProduct.processModel: one CLR process, one bounded central pump, no process or dedicated thread per bot

canonicalSwarm.networkIdentity: independent UDP transport/session/application/control identity per client

botProcessTelemetry.workingSetSampling: fresh current RSS sampled at most every 250 ms across admission through retirement
botProcessTelemetry.interpretation: Small correctness-swarm load-generator telemetry only; includes startup/content/admission/barriers/retirement and is not server performance, bandwidth, cadence, command latency, or a CCU result.

acceptanceInfrastructureCorrections: The native smoke barrier now validates transient one-shot presentation before waiting, remains alive through legitimate bot retirement, and uses a two-client completion barrier before either exported client retires.

Post-chaos native health respects ordinary AOI changes and waits for independently delivered hot actor and cold metadata projections to stabilize; exact old/replacement reconnect identity is verified separately by two ordinary bot observers.
Sword contenders are selected deterministically by distance using only each bot's disclosed public-world state, rather than assuming admission order determines spawn proximity.
The harness retries only transient initial discovery/handshake failures at most eight times with deterministic bounded delay.
The scenario stops generating work and pumps a bounded ten-second quiescence phase before asserting that accepted reliable command/proof debt is empty.
Unexpected transport/application/UI loss faults the bot at every pump and at the completion boundary; cleanup preserves a structured failure result.
Final retirement covers Pending, Connecting, Profile, Content, Active, Draining, and ReconnectDelay and prohibits late admission or reconnect.
A pending command is keyed by application epoch and sequence and must complete or be explicitly cancelled before a replacement lifetime can start.
Chat observation uses one bounded recipient-sequence cursor; chunk coverage distinguishes bounded distinct membership from every crossing.
Run-relative time plus Int128 conversion avoids absolute Stopwatch multiplication overflow.
mixed-chaos rejects fewer than eight bots or less than ten seconds, and admission budgeting includes the final staggered start.

adversarialReview.disposition: NB-01 through NB-05, NB-06, H-01, H-02, M-01, and M-02 were independently confirmed from the source boundary and repaired. NB-06 was confirmed structurally and is covered by an application-epoch pending-command regression plus the real reconnect gate. Eleven maintained focused regressions and the complete exported mixed swarm pass.
adversarialReview.candidateIdentity: The PF0 repaired product candidate remains f003a8b5a2a8f97dac1074e5158ed01c875a83fb because these are PF1 harness/verifier correctness repairs, not a newly discovered product-authority defect.

correctnessRepair.trigger: A capacity-50 dedicated authority exhausted the fixed Inventory container reservation at participant 32 and then faulted public-presentation progress.
correctnessRepair.repair: SharedPlayableAuthorityLimits now derives ECS entity and Inventory container/item reservations from MaximumParticipants.
correctnessRepair.regression: A maintained authority test admits 50 mixed-body participants, copies all 50 public presentations, rejects participant 51 at the advertised bound, and cleanly retires all 50.

manualExploration.interpretation: Exploratory tool/configuration canary only; no CCU or performance claim. The original working-set value used a cached Process sample and is retained only as superseded historical metadata, not a verified peak.

explicitlyNotClaimed: authority support above the currently bounded 64-participant profile
